citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:14PM on
7/7/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone upon arrival. Upon making contact, the licensee
stated no one was available. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of
the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
